bullets.title: Olympic Basketball & The Grateful Dead
bullets.note: The opener: “In 1992, the iconic Grateful Dead music band helped sponsor Lithuania’s national basketball team, a talented but financially-strapped squad that went on to win bronze at the Barcelona Olympics. Their story was a magical tale of tie-dyes, basketball glory, and the birth of a new nation.”

bullets.title: If
bullets.creator: Rudyard Kipling
bullets.note: . From [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/If%E2%80%94): “Boxing great Muhammad Ali was known to carry the poem in his wallet throughout life as a guiding principle.” The legendary financier Carl Icahn, featured in last week’s 5BF, is also intimately familiar with this poem.

bullets.title: Past Lives
bullets.note: ([Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/Past-Lives-Greta-Lee/dp/B0CBHDBRF2/), [Apple TV](https://tv.apple.com/us/movie/past-lives/umc.cmc.tzz5x8oih45dccm7djuquugl?action=play), [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lCKqoIQhHig)). _Past Lives_ currently has **97%** on [Rotten Tomatoes](https://www.rottentomatoes.com/m/past_lives). Description: “Two childhood sweethearts, after decades apart, are reunited for one fateful week in New York as they confront notions of destiny, love, and the choices that make a life in this heartrending modern romance.” You can watch the trailer [here](https://youtu.be/kA244xewjcI?si=VrGroU8_OMS0JGPO). The movie is directed by [Celine Song](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Celine_Song) and stars [Greta Lee](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Greta_Lee), [Teo Yoo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Teo_Yoo), [John Magaro](https://www.instagram.com/J_Magaro/?hl=en), among others.

bullets.title: Organ Blend 95/5 from Maui Nui Venison
bullets.note: From the description: “The best-tasting grind always comes from a mix of muscles from the entire animal. Our ground venison includes trim from neck to leg, loin to belly, and everything in between, ensuring a richness and depth of flavor like no other. With knowledge gained from our recent nutrient analysis, we have made a more balanced 5% organ blend, containing 3.5% liver and 1.5% heart. Since the liver and heart of our venison contain superior nutrient density, this blend offers the benefits of organ meat with an improved flavor profile.” I also suggest using this tool from Maui Nui: [Venison Nutrition Comparison Tool](https://mauinuivenison.com/pages/venison-nutrition-comparison-tool).
